_names: Terminologia Anatomica individual terms (explicitly public domain)
_geometry: TotalSegmentator `total` (Apache-2.0 code and weights), run on our own public-domain CT
_model_values_note: REQUIRED before building. Integer -> label LUT for the segmentation you actually run; values differ between TotalSegmentator versions. Populate with: build.py --print-seg-values <seg.nii.gz>, then map each integer to the label name used in model_labels below. An unmapped integer is skipped, so a partial LUT is safe — the structure simply does not appear.
_clinical_note: Lobar anatomy is the tie-in to the pneumonia / antibiotic pathway: a lobe named here is the same lobe named in a CAP or HAP recommendation.

lung.name: Lung
lung.definition: The lungs are the essential organs of respiration, occupying the pleural cavities on either side of the mediastinum.

upper-lobe-left.name: Left upper lobe
upper-lobe-left.definition: The left lung is divided by the oblique fissure into an upper and a lower lobe; the upper lobe includes the lingula.

lower-lobe-left.name: Left lower lobe
lower-lobe-left.definition: The lower lobe of the left lung lies posteroinferior to the oblique fissure.

upper-lobe-right.name: Right upper lobe
upper-lobe-right.definition: The right lung is divided by oblique and horizontal fissures into upper, middle and lower lobes.

middle-lobe-right.name: Right middle lobe
middle-lobe-right.definition: The middle lobe of the right lung is a wedge lying between the horizontal and oblique fissures.

lower-lobe-right.name: Right lower lobe
lower-lobe-right.definition: The lower lobe of the right lung lies below and behind the oblique fissure.

trachea.name: Trachea
trachea.definition: The trachea is a cartilaginous and membranous tube extending from the larynx to its bifurcation at the carina.

esophagus.name: Oesophagus
esophagus.definition: The oesophagus is a muscular canal passing from the pharynx through the posterior mediastinum to the stomach.

thyroid-gland.name: Thyroid gland
thyroid-gland.definition: The thyroid gland is a highly vascular organ situated in front of the neck, consisting of two lobes joined by an isthmus.

heart.name: Heart
heart.definition: The heart is a hollow muscular organ enclosed in the pericardium, occupying the middle mediastinum.

left-atrial-appendage.name: Left atrial appendage
left-atrial-appendage.definition: The left auricle is a small conical pouch projecting from the upper anterior part of the left atrium.

aorta.name: Aorta
aorta.definition: The aorta is the main arterial trunk, conveying blood from the left ventricle to the body.

pulmonary-artery.name: Pulmonary artery
pulmonary-artery.definition: The pulmonary artery conveys venous blood from the right ventricle to the lungs.

pulmonary-vein.name: Pulmonary vein
pulmonary-vein.definition: The pulmonary veins return oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium.

superior-vena-cava.name: Superior vena cava
superior-vena-cava.definition: The superior vena cava returns blood from the upper half of the body to the right atrium.

inferior-vena-cava.name: Inferior vena cava
inferior-vena-cava.definition: The inferior vena cava returns blood from the lower half of the body to the right atrium.

brachiocephalic-trunk.name: Brachiocephalic trunk
brachiocephalic-trunk.definition: The brachiocephalic trunk is the largest branch of the arch of the aorta, dividing into the right subclavian and right common carotid arteries.

brachiocephalic-vein.name: Brachiocephalic vein
brachiocephalic-vein.definition: The brachiocephalic veins are formed by the union of the internal jugular and subclavian veins on each side.

subclavian-artery.name: Subclavian artery
subclavian-artery.definition: The subclavian artery supplies the upper limb, passing between the scalene muscles.

common-carotid-artery.name: Common carotid artery
common-carotid-artery.definition: The common carotid artery ascends the neck and divides into external and internal carotid arteries.

thoracic-vertebra.name: Thoracic vertebra
thoracic-vertebra.definition: The thoracic vertebrae are distinguished by costal facets on the sides of their bodies.

cervical-vertebra.name: Cervical vertebra
cervical-vertebra.definition: The cervical vertebrae are the smallest of the movable vertebrae and bear foramina in their transverse processes.

rib.name: Rib
rib.definition: The ribs are elastic arches of bone forming the greater part of the thoracic skeleton.

sternum.name: Sternum
sternum.definition: The sternum is a flat narrow bone forming the middle of the anterior thoracic wall.

costal-cartilage.name: Costal cartilage
costal-cartilage.definition: The costal cartilages are bars of hyaline cartilage prolonging the ribs forward to the sternum.

clavicle.name: Clavicle
clavicle.definition: The clavicle forms the anterior portion of the shoulder girdle.

scapula.name: Scapula
scapula.definition: The scapula is a large flat triangular bone on the posterolateral thoracic wall.

humerus.name: Humerus
humerus.definition: The humerus is the longest and largest bone of the upper limb.

spinal-cord.name: Spinal cord
spinal-cord.definition: The spinal cord is the elongated part of the central nervous system occupying the upper two-thirds of the vertebral canal.

autochthonous-back-muscle.name: Deep back muscles
autochthonous-back-muscle.definition: The deep or intrinsic muscles of the back extend and rotate the vertebral column.
